title: MOASYS-Vault — validation.json (audiobooks)
description: Per-book Open Library validation results, joinable to audiobooks.json by title. One entry per scanned book regardless of whether Open Library matched. Generated by `npm run validate:audiobooks`.

status.description: matched: an Open Library edition has this title and a shared author. case: title differs only in capitalization. close: nothing matches, but a same-author title is a typo's distance away. author_mismatch: the title matches but no author does. not_found: nothing resembles the title.

openlibrary_key.description: Open Library work key of the best result, e.g. /works/OL82563W. Null when not_found.

openlibrary_title.description: The best result's title, with its subtitle joined as `Title: Subtitle`.

openlibrary_authors.description: Authors of the best result. Empty when not_found.
